channel.title: Eureka Engine Field Notes
channel.description: Long-form stories from the practical edge of cybersecurity, hardware, digital forensics and AI.

item.title: Can AI design a circuit board? We spent $360 finding out
item.description: I used AI to design a custom circuit board, had five prototypes assembled in China and learned where automation stops being engineering judgement.

item.title: I gave GPT my 20 year old disk decryption challenge. It won.
item.description: How GPT reconstructed an old plain dm-crypt setup, searched a forensic disk image and recovered a deleted encryption key without breaking cryptography.
